_comment: Presence Engine room mapping. 'rooms' defines each room's sensor type + linger. 'devices' maps each Zigbee2MQTT friendly_name to a room — fill these in with the ACTUAL friendly names you give each sensor when pairing (see docs/presence-setup.md). Hot-reloaded on save. mmwave (FP300) is held occupied from the rising edge until the sensor's explicit falling edge, so its linger_s is a long DEAD-SENSOR FAILSAFE ONLY — it must exceed the sensor's longest silence while someone is present (a battery FP300 can go 15+ min without a report when people sit still; periodic reports are guaranteed ~hourly), NOT a short cutoff. Real departures send an explicit false (debounced by PRESENCE_FALLING_CONFIRM_S). pir (SNZB-03P/PR2) is ALSO a held level sensor — it holds occupancy:true for its Detection Duration (~60s) after the last motion, then emits ONE explicit false; it never re-sends an unchanged true, so the room is HELD occupied from the rising edge until that device false, after which linger_s is a SHORT grace before vacating (NOT a cap on how long a present person is held — the old 'linger from last motion' model wrongly cut off a continuously-present person at linger_s). last_positive is only a long stuck-sensor failsafe (PRESENCE_PIR_FAILSAFE_S). Room names must match LIGHT_ROOM in scripts/lights_optimizer.py.
